headline: Executive order creates a new presidential commission focused on health, officially named the Make America Healthy Again Commission.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new commission within the executive branch, called the President's Make America Healthy Again Commission. The title does not describe the commission's members, duties, or deadlines, so its specific tasks cannot be confirmed from the information provided.

who_it_affects.how: Some federal officials will likely serve on or support the new commission, though the title does not say which ones.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 13, 2025; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
